forbidden: Authority semantics, historical signatures/records, other Git helper changes without observed defect
pre_mortem: Larger output might silently truncate or skip late markers.
detection: Actual signed-candidate full-byte positive, late-marker negative,16MiBoverflow plus retained resolver cases.
rollback: Revert bounded maxBuffer option; preserve evidence.
stop: Unreviewed semantics or test change, truncation, check bypass.
